# beneficiaries

Beneficiaries records in CORE and product extensions. Product articles define their operational scope.

Read this collection using `search_records(resource="beneficiaries", filters={}, cursor=0, limit=20)` or `get_record(resource="beneficiaries", record_id="<returned id>")`.

**Filters:** exact scalar equality; in, contains, gte and lte operator objects on supported top-level fields. See DB-query-syntax for type and null behavior.

Search returns selected summary fields, so omission from a summary is not proof of absence from the complete record. Read detail before interpreting an optional field. Fields depend on the record type and processing stage; null and absent fields are not zero amounts. Types below describe public record shapes, rather than mandatory properties on every row.

This inherited collection has no populated public-record shape in the current admitted workflow inventory. Its query entry remains available. No empty collection is treated as evidence about a particular customer enquiry; the actual query determines accessible matches. Its producers and product articles govern any records it creates.
